summary:
One low-risk finding:

- [gc_read_call_facts.go:148](/tmp/wago-gc-immutable-loop-homes/src/core/compiler/backend/railshot/amd64/gc_read_call_facts.go:148): During inlining, the error uses the outer `globalIdx` with the inner callee’s `wasmPC`. This can report the wrong function and offset pair. Use `traceFuncIdx`, or report both owner and active function. The assertion still stops compilation.

No safety blocker found.

The SIMD list matches `emitFD`. Stores, reserved codes, and relaxed SIMD are excluded. Scalar storage is not widened. V128 array reads use the separate final-layout gate. Native fallbacks use bounded frame scratch. Traps do not resume. Root maps and call clobber handling stay unchanged.

I did not build or run tests, as requested.
